programme.title: The House at the End of Time
programme.desc: Dulce est une jeune mère qui a des hallucinations. Elle voit des apparitions dans sa maison qui un jour déclenche la prophétie et tue tous les habitants sauf elle. Trente ans plus tard elle se réinstalle dans sa demeure afin d'élucider le mystère.

programme.title: The Witch In The Window
programme.desc: Lorsque Simon, père divorcé, amène son fils de douze ans, Finn, dans une région rurale du Vermont pour aider à remettre en état une ancienne ferme, ils rencontrent l'esprit malin de Lydia, l'ancienne propriétaire, décédée bien que n'ayant jamais quitté les lieux.

programme.title: Mass Murderer
programme.desc: Eva est une jeune femme flic chargée des affaires de vols au sein de la ville de Barcelone. Un jour, elle est appelée en urgence pour rejoindre l'unité qui traque une tueuse en série ayant pour cible les vieilles femmes. Alors qu'un vent de panique s'abat sur la ville, la jeune femme pourtant novice dans ce genre d'affaires, va tenter de mettre la main sur la meurtrière… C'est sans ompter la bataille personnelle qu'elle va devoir mener de front contre son inspecteur en chef, qui passe son temps à lui fermer la porte au nez et lui compliquer la tâche au sein de l'unité.

programme.title: Sacrifices
programme.desc: Un groupe d'Américains atterit au Mexique pour un voyage éducatif organisé par le père O'Sullivan. Le programme prévoit non seulement la visite guidée des temples aztèques et mayas, mais aussi une découverte des rites sanguinaires apparemment reconstitués par les tribus d'Oaxaca. Mais peu à peu, les spectateurs s'aperçoivent que les scènes meurtrières sont plus vrais que nature.

programme.title: Nazis au centre de la terre
programme.desc: Des chercheurs en Antarctique sont enlevés et traînés sous terre par une équipe de survivants nazis qui planifient la renaissance du Troisième Reich.

programme.title: SOS chasseurs de monstres
programme.desc: Un groupe de pré-adolescents ingénieux lancent après l'école un business d'“extermination” de monstres imaginaires pour débarrasser leurs jeunes voisins des créatures qui se cachent sous leurs lits ou dans leurs penderies.

programme.title: Plouf! Petit Poisson Courageux
programme.desc: Quand une mystérieuse substance noire envahit une petite ville sous-marine idyllique, un courageux poisson décide de traverser l'océan pour trouver sa source et sauver son corail.

programme.title: Les Lunnis et leurs Aventures Magiques
programme.desc: Marie est une jeune fille pleine d'imagination grâce aux contes racontés par son grand-père. Un jour, le méchant Crude découvre le moyen d'en finir avec le Livre magique qui contient toutes les histoires inventées par l'Humanité et son gardien Lucrecia.

programme.title: A.R.C.H.I.E Chien Robot
programme.desc: Isabel, 15 ans, part s'installer chez son oncle dans une peLte ville des Etats-Unis après la mort de ses parents. Sa vie change le jour où elle rencontre Archie, un chien robot très convoité aux pouvoirs extraordinaires…

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: Seconde Guerre Mondiale. Le capitaine américain Jack Wosick, récemment tombé en disgrâce, se voit offrir un moyen de se racheter lorsqu'on lui propose de commander une unité de marginaux sans aucune discipline, les « War Pigs ».

programme.title: Get Fast
programme.desc: Quand son complice est enlevé après un braquage spectaculaire, un voleur notoire se lance à sa recherche sur le territoire d'un impitoyable baron de la drogue. Jusqu'où va la loyauté entre criminels quand les balles commencent à siffler ?

programme.title: Justice Armée
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il apprend que son frère a été assassiné pendant son service militaire, Webster se met à la recherche des auteurs du meurtre. Il découvre alors une conspiration qui remonte jusqu'au gouvernement américain.

programme.title: Cartel Escape
programme.desc: Carla, une jeune mexicaine, se retrouve par accident aux États-Unis après avoir traversé un tunnel abandonné. Au cœur du désert de Yucca Valley, elle se retrouve alors prise dans un jeu mortel du chat et de la souris entre la CIA, le cartel et des informateurs du gouvernement.

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: Nicolas Shaw fait partie d'une équipe d'élite secrète qui élimine les pires tueurs du monde. Après avoir été accusé de l'assassinat d'un membre de son équipe, il doit laver son nom et empêcher le meurtre des autres agents...

programme.title: Un conte de la Goutte d'or
programme.desc: Dans le quartier de la Goutte d'or, quatre jeunes solitaires que rien ne lie, vont se rencontrer à la suite de minuscules incidents. S'en suit une aventure au coeur de l'un des plus célèbres quartiers de Paris.

programme.title: Regarder Oana
programme.desc: Oana travaille. Et moi je la regarde. Ce soir, ce dernier dossier sera plié. Elle ne veut plus traduire les mots des autres. Elle pense que demain elle va commencer à écrire pour elle. Mais elle ne le fera pas. Je le sais....

programme.title: Bleu-Gris
programme.desc: Fin août. Corse. Elbe, dix-sept ans, sourde de naissance est en vacances chez sa grande sœur Mathilde. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au phare de la Revellata, elle aperçoit un homme qui remonte seul d'une plongée sous marine…

programme.title: Rase campagne
programme.desc: Un village perdu dans la campagne finistérienne. Un homme est suspecté d'être porteur du virus Ebola. Il est noir. C'est Maurice. Son meilleur ami, Michel, ambulancier, sillonne le territoire avec son stagiaire Rémi pour le retrouver et le contrôler…

programme.title: Les amoureuses
programme.desc: Sara a quinze ans elle passe ses journées d'été au bord de la piscine accompagnée de sa mère, de sa petite sœur et de ses copines. La fin du mois d'août sera traversée par la rencontre d'un jeune homme, Lilian, pour lequel Sara et sa mère éprouvent le même désir.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Toutes les belles choses
programme.desc: Le jour se lève. Tout le monde dort, sauf la mariée, Jessica. Elle est bientôt rejointe par Cathy, qui ne dort pas non plus. Ce sont les plus vieilles amies de la terre et elles vont passer un peu de temps ensemble, ce matin.

programme.title: La répétition
programme.desc: Stéphane rêve de devenir comédien. Carole, elle, rêve d'une augmentation.

programme.title: Haram
programme.desc: Leila est marocaine, Mathieu est français. Ils vivent ensemble depuis deux ans. Leila étant depuis peu en situation irrégulière, ils ont pris la décision de se marier. Le mariage approche et il ne leur manque plus qu'un document. Le certificat de célibat de Leila, qui ne leur sera délivré que si la jeune femme épouse un musulman. Pas le choix, Mathieu doit se convertir à l'Islam.

programme.title: Traversées
programme.desc: Ca tourne, ça virevolte, ça chute... sur la patinoire. Agile ou grotesque, chacun s'essaie à l'art du patinage. Le film est une ode. Ode à cette vie précaire, ode à cette arène où tant de personnes sont passées pour une heure, une journée, un amour...

programme.title: The Face, The Heel... et Corentin
programme.desc: Corentin est un nouvel élève du catch club de Cognac. Réservé, sincère et persévérant, le jeune homme se donne à fond pour atteindre son objectif : lutter aux Etats-Unis ou à l'étranger. Mais a-t-il l'étoffe d'un catcheur pour y parvenir ?

programme.title: Mrs Aylwood ne veut pas mourir
programme.desc: Dans une demeure isolée, Susan Aylwood, ancienne star du cinéma, vit avec sa gouvernante la discrète Caroline. Entourée de ses souvenirs de gloire, elle mène son entourage à la baguette. Mais quelle terrible vérité se cache derrière les apparences ?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia est entraînée dans un appartement pour une fête. Face à la foule de visages, elle est sans repères, comme perdue dans un paysage de montagne recouvert de nuages.

programme.title: Garage rouge
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon n'ose plus sortir de chez lui après une agression.

programme.title: A perdre haleine
programme.desc: Emile, jeune violoncelliste, est submergé par l'angoisse le jour d'un concert...

programme.title: Léon d'Oural
programme.desc: Au cours d'une prestigieuse course, des chevaux, poussés par les jockeys, enchaînent avec vigueur les obstacles.

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: Blanche
programme.desc: Un homme part de la vallée, pour aller chercher des glaciers, des sommets. Il fuit un monde bruyant, polluant. Un monde qui fait fondre les glaciers, qui les réchauffent et les fait disparaître. Il monte, s'éloigne et toujours, pourtant, il sait que le monde d'en bas le poursuit.

programme.title: Papa dans maman
programme.desc: Milieu de la nuit. Des gémissements se font entendre derrière la porte des parents. Deux jeunes soeurs s'interrogent...

programme.title: Le quepa sur la vilni !
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, André sort de sa paisible retraite . Sur ordre du maire, il doit mener à travers monts une troupe d'hommes-sandwichs à vélo pour attirer les spectateurs à l'inauguration du cinéma local.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Stormageddon
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un programme informatique, Echelon, prend le contrôle des systèmes informatiques américains, il devient capable de manipuler la météo. Deux robots, Adam et Cain, se battent pour prendre le contrôle d'Echelon avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Projet Philadelphie, l'Expérience Interdite
programme.desc: En 1943, un projet secret d'occultation du gouvernement tourne mal et fait disparaître un destroyer de la marine. En 2012, le destroyer réapparaît, déclenchant une série d'événements qui menacent de détruire le monde.

programme.title: TOMIRIS
programme.desc: Voici l'histoire de la grande reine des steppes, la légendaire Tomyris. Destinée à devenir une guerrière habile, elle devra survivre à la perte de ses proches et unir les tribus scythes/sakas sous son autorité.

programme.title: Shred
programme.desc: Max et Eddy sont d'anciens snowboardeurs professionnels des années 90 qui ont ruiné leur carrière à cause de leur comportement imprudent. Travaillant désormais comme opérateurs de remontées mécaniques à Stubby Peaks, ils décident de créer un camp/équipe de snowboard pour revenir sur le devant de la scène. Kingsley Brown, leur ancien rival et président de l'Association Nationale de Snowboard, fait tout pour discréditer leur camp et empêcher ces fous dangereux de revenir dans le sport. Max et Eddy doivent alors partir à la recherche de nouveaux talents prometteurs pour rejoindre leur équipe et participer à la prochaine compétition de snowboard.

programme.title: A deadly vision
programme.desc: Une serveuse qui a des visions psychiques de meurtres avant qu'elles ne se produisent est sollicitée par un détective de police pour l'aider à retrouver un tueur en série.

programme.title: J'aurais Voulu Etre Un Danseur
programme.desc: François mène une vie paisible et heureuse avec sa ravissante épouse et son jeune fils jusquà ce qu'il découvre pour la première fois la comédie musicale "Singin' in the rain". Hypnotisé, il quitte sa famille pour se consacrer à sa nouvelle et dévorante passion pour les claquettes. Mais il ne sait pas encore que son père et son grand-père ont fait la même chose des années auparavant...

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Ben emménage dans une nouvelle maison. L'adolescent se lie d'amitié avec leur nouveau voisin, qui est en fait le célèbre magicien Merlin. Alors que ce dernier affronte la terrible fée Morgane, il enseigne à Ben les rudiments de la magie.

programme.title: Alice Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Dans ce conte classique, Alice tombe à travers un miroir et arrive dans un endroit merveilleux appelé le Pays des Merveilles ! Le voyage d'Alice à travers les huit carrés fous du Pays des Merveilles est présenté à l'écran dans un film d'animation de haute qualité, divertissant pour vos enfants et votre famille. En chemin, Alice rencontre des amis comme Bonnet blanc, et des ennemis tels que le méchant Jaseroque et le Bandersnatch !

programme.title: Breathe
programme.desc: L'histoire insprirante et vraie d'amour entre Robin et Diana Cavendish, un couple aventureux qui refuse d'abandonner face à une maladie dévastatrice. Leur célébration réconfortante de la possibilité humaine marque les débuts du réalisateur d'Andy Serkis.L'histoire insprirante et vraie d'amour entre Robin et Diana Cavendish, un couple aventureux qui refuse d'abandonner face à une maladie dévastatrice. Leur célébration réconfortante de la possibilité humaine marque les débuts du réalisateur d'Andy Serkis.

programme.title: Le Prix de la Rédemption
programme.desc: Après seize ans de prison pour meurtre, Adam retrouve son quartier avec l'espoir de rencontrer le fils qu'il n'a jamais connu. Mais le frère de sa victime rôde. Mike, lui, veut échapper au trafic de son oncle. Quand leurs destins se croisent, une spirale de violence s'enclenche.

programme.title: Keeping Mum
programme.desc: Un pasteur préoccupé par l'écriture du sermon parfait ne voit pas que sa femme le trompe et que ses enfants préparent un mauvais coup.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Le Livre de l'Amour
programme.desc: Henry et Penny vivent à la Nouvelle-Orléans et forment un couple très amoureux, jusqu'à ce que la tragédie frappe. Henry est alors contraint de se reconstruire. Après s'être lié d'amitié avec une adolescente à la rue revêche, il décide de l'aider à construire un radeau pour traverser l'Atlantique.

programme.title: Coup de foudre au manoir
programme.desc: Isabella et Blake organisent une fête au manoir, ignorant les surprises qui les attendent.

programme.title: L'amour en cuisine
programme.desc: Une chef parie de redresser le pire restaurant, mais l'amour du propriétaire grincheux est la clé.

programme.title: Mariage sanglant
programme.desc: Pour fuir sa tante, une couturière est prête à tuer la fiancée de l'homme de ses rêves pour l'épouser.

programme.title: Un coeur a louer
programme.desc: Poppy et Milo feignent des fiançailles pour un job et un appart. La situation leur échappe vite.

programme.title: Our Idiot Brother
programme.desc: Ned (Paul Rudd) est bien intentionné, mais le bon sens lui fait défaut. Alors quand il débarque dans la vie de ses trois sœurs (Emily Mortimer, Elizabeth Banks, et Zooey Deschanel), les rires sont garantis.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Lorsque Joel et Molly se rencontrent, c'est la haine à première vue : lui et sa grande corporation Candy Company menacent de fermer son magasin de bonbons indépendant et original à elle. De plus, Joel est obsédé par son ex sexy. Mais étonnamment , ils tombent amoureux, jusqu'à ce qu'ils se séparent environ aux deux tiers du chemin, et Molly commence à sortir avec son comptable.

programme.title: La femme du juge
programme.desc: Un détective avisé se retrouve mêlé à la vie louche d'un juge et de sa femme, de toute évidence liés à un homme aux penchants criminels.

programme.title: Philadelphia Experiment II
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller de science-fiction, le survivant d'expériences de guerre est envoyé 41 ans dans le futur. Dans une course contre la montre, il doit sauver le monde en 1993.

programme.title: Sous surveillance
programme.desc: Une enquête policière qui se déroule à Boston, inspirée du roman de Lisa Gardner et centrée sur la chasse à un tueur en série potentiel.

programme.title: Sexy Therapy
programme.desc: Adam vient de rencontrer Phoebe, qui pourrait bien être la femme de sa vie, mais il est accro au sexe. Il soigne sa dépendance au sein d'un groupe de parole composé d'autres addicts de la galipette.

programme.title: Reset
programme.desc: Xia Tian et son équipe bûchent depuis des années sur une technologie permettant de voyager dans l'espace-temps. Les expériences n'ont jamais été tentées sur des matières vivantes et le rayon de fonctionnement ne remonte pas au-delà de 110 minutes.

programme.title: Bye Bye Love
programme.desc: New York, 1963. Une chroniqueuse, dont le nouveau roman qui rejette l'amour est couronné de succès, tombe sous le charme d'un journaliste tombeur de ces dames qui décide de la séduire…

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: Après le crash d'une météorite géante sur la lune, son axe est modifié et l'entraine en direction de notre planète. Un groupe de scientifiques doit trouver un moyen d'empêcher la lune d'entrer en collision avec la Terre avant qu'il ne soit trop tard…

programme.desc: Retrouvez tous les dossiers spéciaux sur le cinéma et les séries.

programme.desc: Gaffes, erreurs, ratés, Michel et Michel vous disent tout sur vos film et séries préférés.

programme.desc: Mêlant archives et interviews, ce documentaire dévoile qui était l'homme derrière le légendaire Walt Disney.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: Y-a-t-il un youtuber dans l'avion ?
programme.desc: En route pour la plus grande convention de médias sociaux au monde en Australie, Logan Paul est mort de peur c'est la première fois qu'il prend l'avion. Tous ses pires cauchemars deviennent réalité lorsque les passagers refusent de passer leurs téléphones en mode avion...

programme.title: Lucky girl
programme.desc: Ashley est la femme la plus chanceuse de New York. Mais sa chance s'intervertit bizarrement avec celle du jeune homme le plus malchanceux de la ville.

programme.title: Love, Romance & Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de Chocolatier Rayal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolats uniques, mais gagneront-t-ils sans qu'ils y perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez joue le rôle d'une fille ordinaire dont le voyage d'été à Paris se transforme en rêve de sa vie lorsqu'elle devient une princesse accidentelle en assumant l'identité d'une autre personne.

programme.title: Fandango
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un cavalier expert subit un accident traumatisant avec son meilleur cheval il surmonte sa blessure avec l'aide d'une jeune fille qui contribue à sa réhabilitation et à celle du cheval Fandango.

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Le réalisateur de cinéma arrogant et égocentrique Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) se retrouve en pleine crise, cherchant un sens, un but et un scénario pour son nouveau projet de film. À seulement une semaine du début du tournage, il cherche désespérément des réponses et de l'inspiration auprès de sa femme, sa maîtresse, sa muse et sa mère. Alors que sa vie professionnelle chaotique menace de détruire sa vie personnelle, Guido doit trouver un équilibre entre la création artistique et les exigences obsessionnelles de son métier.

programme.title: Et beaucoup plus si affinités
programme.desc: WHAT IF raconte l'histoire de Wallace, un étudiant en médecine qui a abandonné ses études après avoir été déçu par de nombreuses relations amoureuses. Alors que tous ceux qui l'entourent, y compris son colocataire Allan, semblent trouver le partenaire idéal, Wallace décide de mettre sa vie amoureuse en pause. C'est alors qu'il rencontre Chantry, une animatrice qui vit avec son petit ami de longue date, Ben. Wallace et Chantry se lient immédiatement d'amitié et développent une relation très proche. Pourtant, l'alchimie entre eux est indéniable, ce qui les amène à se demander : et si l'amour de votre vie était en réalité votre meilleur ami ?

programme.title: Love Hacks

programme.title: How The Taliban Really Works
programme.desc: Sean Langan is a British journalist and documentary filmmaker who has spent decades reporting from some of the world's most dangerous conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq and Russia. He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right

programme.title: Extinction! Going, Going, Gone
programme.desc: Extinction, a daunting and confusing word. A force of nature, that sees the end of species, but also heralds the birth of others. Right now the extinction rate could be as much as 10,000 times faster than it should be. 20% of fish, a fifth of all reptiles and a quarter of mammals face extinction. If we are to do anything to stem the tide of extinction we must understand the lifestyles of those in danger. The future for countless animals is uncertain, but one thing is for sure – we have a lot to learn.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year.

programme.title: The World From Above

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble. And they're not just stealthy, they're also some of the most enigmatic and beautiful creatures on the planet.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Endangered with Michaela Strachan
programme.desc: Seeks to find the rare and endangered species of South Africa and establish what we need to do to conserve them. Documenting and recording the status of our endangered species by region.

programme.title: Ice Dogs
programme.desc: Conditions in the High Arctic are too extreme for either man or dog to survive alone but together we have become native to the vast white expanses. Here dogs became our greatest allies. They're our eyes, ears, strength and stamina our closest connection to a wild and unforgiving nature. In this magical yet unforgiving land, the enduring bond between human and canine goes beyond friendship to total mutual dependence. As one of the oldest breeds in the world, Greenland dogs are celebrated as the pinnacle of high performance and endurance in polar regions.

programme.title: Penguins: The African Chaplin
programme.desc: The African penguin is the only penguin species in Africa. Their clumsy demeanour has seen them called the Charlie Chaplins of the bird world. But they are struggling to escape extinction. Despite the protection of their breeding islands, numbers fall. Scientists race to find the answers for the staggering decline. Is there a glimmer of hope for the African Chaplin?

programme.title: mareTV: Corsica
programme.sub-title: Fascinating Mountain World in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Corsica looks like an alpine landscape in the Mediterranean, an island with dramatic rock formations, romantic bays and proud inhabitants who see themselves first and foremost as Corsicans and only then as French. The Greeks in ancient times called the island Kalliste: the beautiful. We explore this fascinating mountain world in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It's a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It's a country that's astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Project Antarctica
programme.desc: Why don't you do something sensible? - Tim, Michael and Dennis have heard this sentence more than once since their school days when they professed their dream jobs: Artist, photographer, filmmaker. And they went on to say that some dreams had to remain dreams, that work didn't have to be fun, but above all that it had to pay enough and be safe. A few years later, the three are working on their joint feature film. They put all their eggs in one basket and are determined to invest two years of working time to achieve their goal. Unpaid. It's not just any goal: the three want to travel to Antarctica. They want to find out whether it is possible to reach even the most distant destinations if you only want to. With ten boxes full of equipment, they set off on the 14,000 km journey to Antarctica. And thus on the journey of a lifetime...

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: Mountains
programme.desc: A mother lynx feeds on freshly caught prey with her cubs, agile chamoix leap along mountain ledges, bee-eaters dig nesting holes in vineyards, black storks bring up their young on narrow ridges. From the rugged peaks of the Alps and the dark woods of the Black Forest to the sandstone cliffs of Saxonian Switzerland, Germany's mountains are home to very special animals. The episode Mountains from the four-part series Wild Germany shows a world full of breath-taking images. We witness the first few days of baby marmots in Alpine meadows, inexperienced and unaware of the dangers lurking outside the den. The opportunity that the golden eagle in the cliff face has been waiting for. Taking to the air, it glides over the steeply sloping pasture. The older marmots recognize the danger and send out shrill alarm whistles. Will the younger marmots heed the warnings in time? It's been more than 150 years since the last lynx was seen in Germany. After a reintroduction project in the Czech Republic, the first big cats crossed the border into the Bavarian forest. Similar projects in the Harz mountains have also brought the lynx back to Northern Germany. Only 30km South of Dresden, majestic table mountains stretch into the sky: Saxonian Switzerland with its unspoilt rocky cliffs and towers. Habitat of peregrine falcons and white-throated dippers, as well as the shy and seldom seen dormouse. The spectacular beauty and diversity of form of the Elbe Sandstone Mountains are unique in Europe. The film shows the magnificence of the mountains in the different seasons and the rich variety of flora and fauna. Unique animal footage rounds off the portrait of landscapes which have much more than just barren rocks to offer.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. Strawberry good-naturedly chuckles at her antics. But Orange gets her dander up and wades into the water to face her "attacker." When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers. With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.desc: "Do you understand now why I said sorry?" I asked suddenly. "Yeah, but now what?" Tea put me in a dilemma. "Now what? Now what? Now, 'search'." I stood up, answering. "Search" for whom and for what? Watch the first part of our new journey, "Search."

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: "What about your search?" Tea asks, igniting your frustration. "I don't understand anything," you confess. Tea calms you, a sip resets the mood, and the next chapter of your "Tea" journey unfolds.

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: You ponder friendship's true meaning, asking tea, "How do you answer that?" Tea, your confidant, assures you that a listener awaits. A sip of tea promises the answer as you delve into "Friend," the third part of your journey.

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: Tea reveals "Dev" as your new listener, making you laugh and faint. But you're still waiting for Kishan. "Will he come?" you ask. "Only God—Dev—knows," Tea wisely replies, leaving you in quiet contemplation. Unravel the next chapter in "Dev."

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: I saw Kishan! So happy! you exclaim to Tea. Its retort, "Will Kishan be happy?" shatters your joy. Your perplexed "What now?" is met with Tea's pensive "Now, a meeting..." leaving you silent. The next step awaits in "A Visit."

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: Why are you silent? Tea asks, cutting through your quiet. "Not saying no..." you mutter. Tea, eagerly, declares the sole solution: Kishan. Armed with this fresh perspective, you leave. What happens next in "Kishan"?

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: Tea's sudden question, "Very happy today?" uncovers your concealed delight. It deduces love is the cause, playfully pressing, "Who is he? Dev or Kishan?" Your mixed reaction of laughter and worry sets the stage for "Tea and Love."

programme.title: Bas Cha Sudhi
programme.desc: "Tea with Dev is over, now who is left? Me and Kishan. Hmmm, now Kishan, me, and tea. Kishan, me, tea, love again?" See what happens, In Chapter 2 of Part 7 of Our Journey.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented quintet ONEWE! ONEWE is an alternative rock band composed of YongHoon KangHyun HaRin DongMyeong and CyA. The band's name is a combination of one and and we shine on you which speaks to the members' ambition to shine on everyone and become one in the name of music. With exceptional talents in songwriting and lyric-writing the five young musicians never fail to impress listeners. Not surprisingly the quintet is expanding their audience reach both at home and abroad and their single Q entered the Billboard World Digital Song Sales Chart in April last year. Each member boasts his own distinctive musical talents so their music is versatile and kaleidoscopic yet harmonious. In this episode ONEWE performs Regulus Crazy ONEWE Medley and more to show off their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these talented ambitious five artists!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is superb vocalist Jung Seung-hwan! With his trademark heartwarming voice this artist is known for his winter songs including The Snowman and My Christmas Wish. In time for the season he's back with another winter classic - Winter Again. Topping all the major charts with his latest single he once again proved his mainstream popularity. Also he took part in the song Our Christmas Wish For You released by his label and genuinely comforted listeners going through this difficult time. In this episode Jung Seung-hwan performs The Snowman Whenever Wherever Fine and more to keep us warm during this cold season. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented vocalist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter JEONG SEWOON! programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: House On Wheels 2 EP1
